title: A perfect gift for a movie night (red Meltie mug, living-room background)
notes: Exact replica of the Short with ONLY the background changed: behind the desk, a cosy living room at night (a warm taupe wall, a wooden bookshelf with books and a trailing plant, a glowing paper floor lamp) replaces the red wall and the Christmas tree. Desk, mug, laptop, candle jar, board, hands, actions, framing and timing follow the original. RED variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photo IMG_3997 + lifestyle photo IMG-4084). The laptop is a green screen composited with original generated stills of a fictional 1980s series (no real show footage); the KitKat bag is a plain unbranded red foil bag; Sora audio stands in for the original soundtrack. compare.trim + luma grade: the new background is not scored as an error and keeps its colours.
